_note: Nutrition values are indicative estimates calculated from each recipe using standard fruit composition data, for a 70 g pop. Replace with lab-tested values before launch. Allergen statements cover the recipe only; confirm factory cross-contact with the co-packer.

flavours.name: Freckle Mango
flavours.blurb: Sunny, sticky, a bit freckly. Made from mangoes too spotty for the supermarket shelf.
flavours.fruit: Mangoes with skin marks and odd shapes
flavours.allergens: No major allergens in the recipe.

flavours.name: Bumpy Berry
flavours.blurb: Squished, lopsided berries that still taste like berries. Funny that.
flavours.fruit: Undersized and misshapen strawberries, raspberries and blueberries
flavours.ingredients: Rescued mixed berries (70%) (strawberry, raspberry, blueberry), apple juice (20%), water.
flavours.allergens: No major allergens in the recipe.

flavours.name: Wonky Watermelon
flavours.blurb: From melons that grew a little too wonky to stack. Still crunchy-sweet inside, with a squeeze of lime.
flavours.allergens: No major allergens in the recipe.

flavours.name: Wrinkly Orange & Passionfruit
flavours.blurb: Bumpy oranges and wrinkly passionfruit. The wrinklier, the tastier.
flavours.ingredients: Rescued orange (60%), rescued passionfruit pulp (15%), water.
flavours.allergens: No major allergens in the recipe.
